web_description_html:
Magnesium Bisglycinate 200 mg provides 200 mg of magnesium (magnesium bisglycinate) per vegetable capsule. Helps to maintain proper muscle function, including the heart muscle. Helps in the development and maintenance of bones and teeth. Helps to prevent magnesium deficiency. Helps in energy metabolism and in tissue formation.

NPN 80098765

Serving: 1 capsule, 1 to 2 times daily; form: vegetable capsule.
